correctness.rationale: A complete all-n proof uses the cross-transversal iff-inverse lemma, explicit kernel/image parameterizations and three-case formulas. Direct branch substitutions show both sandwich identities and square-one pairings. Self-inverse cases coincide exactly with idempotents; the sums yield fixed counts binom(n+1,3), 2(n-1) and transposition counts binom(n,3), binom(n-1,2). Exhaustive direct-function checker for 2<=n<=18 independently validates all identities and counts. It is a finite check, not the proof.

originality.rationale: The full 2026 same-object source establishes only an unrestricted permutation matching, and its proof does not force involution or give these two rank-specific formulas; the 2019 larger-domain involution is not closed on O_n. Novel contribution is explicit involutive pairings fixing exactly idempotents, with exact cycle numbers, for two natural infinite families of Green classes. Targeted semantic and full-text comparisons did not identify a dominating theorem. This is best-knowledge novelty, not independently established absolute priority.

value.rationale: Against the recently proved all-rank permutation matching for O_n, an order-two inverse matching is the next stricter structural problem. Explicit constructions for the first and last nontrivial Green classes in every chain length isolate tractable boundaries of this refinement, prove the stronger property there, and quantify precise fixed/transposition orbit spectra. These formulas are not arbitrary small-instance tables. This is a natural useful partial structural result, not a claimed whole-monoid solution or general downstream theorem.
